title: Page 273
transc:
Hd Qrs A of J Dec 5 1864
Geo D Sheldon F Monroe 11.35 Am
Florence for pilgrim Edson have immed'y all
the pow dear of which I spoke
put in sand bugs & flour sacks
ready for ship meant pekin see Niagara
on the subject pedlar get the bags
at Randolph queenly at appian pekin of
not notify me by wrangle yoke knave
R OBrien


Washington Dec. 5th 1864 
Geo D. Sheldon
Henrietta plaster for pilgrim Edson animal confidential zebra send
immed'y to hill town head avon all ordnance supplies
which have been ordered for kidnaps oyster unity write
to lute arnold ordnance officer at hill town heard
to hold these supplies on board vassail toby landed
and issued at such place or places as may
be there ordered yoke a be dire palsy chief
T. T. Eckert .


Hd Qrs A of James Dec 6th / 64
Geo D Sheldon
Fanny for niagara zebra what day can
we start from appian zodiac I wish
not to keep whiskey on board train
sports a day longer than possible pedlar
as it will take some days to
reach garter any way zebra is there
any thing I can did you in
yoke Knave whatever is is right pope
R OBrien
